name: APLUX
summary: APLUX is a Chengdu-based developer of edge AI software and robotic systems. Its fusion operating system and AI deployment tools support intelligent robots, industrial inspection and edge computing. APLUX co-developed and released the Ultra Magnus humanoid prototype with Ti5 Robot and Qualcomm technology: APLUX supplies the operating system and edge AI integration, while Ti5 contributes joint modules and motion-control algorithms.
